connections.why: Men nursed the sick under vows long before any school trained them: the Hospitallers of Jerusalem were a brotherhood of men serving the sick, the older line the brothers' orders and the Mills School's men came after.
The word2vec vectors trained on Google News answered "a father is to a doctor as a mother is to x" with nurse, the assumption about who nurses that the men's schools ran against.
The acts that made the Army and Navy nurse corps female kept the men the schools trained out of military nursing until 1955.
